title: Forcing confidence: a Process Tracing approach with a dynamical systems model
summary: We propose a continuous time dynamical system model for tracing the evolution of confidence in a small decision making group by consensus with the possibility that a forcing factor is exerted onto the confidence of the participants. We experimentally check whether a forcing factor appears, where it begins and ends and how it affects the evolution. We find that the equilibrium value of the confidence is lower in the model with the forcing factor than without it, and that the forcing factor can be identified and induces additional oscillations of the confidence level.
